title: Tesla rolls out FSD v15, featuring a photorealistic rendering of car surroundings; Elon Musk says it is real-time AI video generation without using game engines (Mike Pearl/Gizmodo)
summary: Mike Pearl / Gizmodo: Tesla rolls out FSD v15, featuring a photorealistic rendering of car surroundings; Elon Musk says it is real-time AI video generation without using game engines — FSD v15 was released to some vehicles on Saturday. Its visualization system may be the most remarkable part.
